note: Versioned pipeline registry (safe-versioning policy, docs/15). Select the active pipeline with ONE value (env PIPELINE_MODE overrides `active`), never by editing source. HYBRID POLICY (user-locked 2026-07-16): composite-v1 is the DEFAULT; legacy is kept only for manual experimentation and is NEVER used automatically. On any shot the composite cannot produce faithfully (e.g. a worn angle unavailable from the 2D CAD), SKIP and request more source material (more CAD angles / a 3D model) - never let AI redraw the jewelry. Missing an image is preferable to a geometrically incorrect product.

composite-v1.description: DEFAULT (user-locked 2026-07-16). AI generates only the scene; the REAL source-CAD ring pixels are composited in - geometry identical to source by construction. Studio: always composite. Lifestyle/closeup: composite when the worn angle is achievable from source; else request more source or SKIP - never invent geometry.

legacy.description: Prompt-based MCP generation workflow. Full-AI scene + ring; geometry may drift (NO guarantee). RETAINED for manual experimentation ONLY - never selected automatically; never a fallback. Available via one-command switch (scripts/rollback-pipeline.*) for experimentation.
